pr31.title: Add eth: paper and Lean 4 formalization of "A 2^o(n) Time Algorithm for 3-SAT"
pr31.body:
Adds eth/, a self-contained Lake project (Lean v4.33.1, Mathlib v4.33.1), with the paper as eth/paper.pdf.
MainResults.lean states two propositions on Mathlib's Turing machines: that the Exponential Time Hypothesis
is false, and the paper's main theorem, that one deterministic machine counts, for every k, the satisfying
assignments of k-CNF formulas within the stated time bound. Solution.lean proves both from the files under
proof/, and comparator.json names them for Comparator. The only two sorry are in Challenge.lean, which states
the two theorems without proofs for that check. eth/README.md says how to check everything.
Adds the project's row to the table of the root README.
